name: Sun Bum

lead: Sun Bum makes sunscreens, lip balms, tanning products, after-sun care and hair care aimed at beach and outdoor users. Its signature SPF is 30, with higher options available.
People use it to keep skin from burning while getting sun, and many looksmaxxers treat daily sunscreen as a foundation for even, younger-looking skin.

paras: Sunscreens use mineral filters such as zinc oxide or titanium dioxide, or organic chemical filters, to absorb or scatter UV light before it reaches the skin. SPF rates protection against burning UVB; broad-spectrum labels indicate UVA coverage as well.[2]

General sunscreen guidance is to apply generously and reapply about every two hours and after swimming. Products vary in ingredients, and the brand lists a mineral line for people who prefer zinc oxide or titanium dioxide filters.

angle.text: Sun Bum products place a UV filter layer on the skin so people can tan or spend time outdoors with less burning. Over time, regular sunscreen use is linked to smoother, more even skin with fewer sun-caused age spots.

lead: Sun Bum is a beach-culture sun care and hair care brand whose sunscreens, lip balms and after-sun products are used to protect skin from UV exposure. Protecting skin from the sun supports an even tone, fewer sun spots and a younger-looking complexion over time. Its tagline is "Trust The Bum", and the brand presents its products as made for people who spend long hours in strong sun, such as surfers.[1]

The range includes Original, Mineral, Daily, Kids and Baby Bum sunscreens, SPF lip balms, tanning oils and lotions, after-sun care and a hair care line. The brand's signature strength is SPF 30, with SPF 50 options also offered, including sprays.[1]

Sunscreen as a category is associated with prevention of sunburn and, with regular broad-spectrum use, with less visible photoaging such as wrinkles, sagging and age spots.[2][3] Within looksmaxxing, sunscreen is commonly discussed as a base habit for skin quality, and Sun Bum is one of the recognizable brands people mention.

paras: The brand's site lists sun care collections (Original, Mineral, Daily, Kids, Baby Bum, Signature), after-sun care and tanning oils and lotions, along with lip care and a hair care range, plus travel sizes and kits.[1] The Original Sunscreen is described by the brand as the formula that started the company.[1]

SPF indicates how well a product guards against sunburn compared with unprotected skin, and a broad-spectrum label means protection against both UVA and UVB.[3] Mineral filters such as zinc oxide and titanium dioxide sit on the skin and mainly absorb UV with some scattering, while chemical filters such as avobenzone absorb UV and release it as heat. The Skin Cancer Foundation says both types are considered safe and effective and that mineral products may irritate skin less.[3][2]

Guidance from the same source is SPF 30 or higher for mostly indoor days with brief sun, SPF 50 or higher for long outdoor exposure, application about 30 minutes before going out and reapplication every two hours and after swimming or sweating. It notes most people apply less than half the amount tested, and that up to 80 percent of UV can reach the ground on cloudy days.[3]

Sunscreen is discussed as protecting skin tone and texture, and tanning-oriented users pair SPF with tanning products to build color more gradually. The Skin Cancer Foundation reports that daily use helps prevent sun-caused premature aging such as wrinkles, sagging and age spots, and cites studies finding daily SPF 15 use reduced squamous cell carcinoma by about 40 percent and melanoma by about 50 percent when used as directed.[3]
The brand's site links to a page on compliance with Hawaii's reef-related sunscreen law and to a nonprofit, Protect The Groms.[1]
No studies found on Sun Bum products specifically. Studies of daily sunscreen use in general are summarized in Wikipedia's sunscreen article and by the Skin Cancer Foundation.[2][3]
